title: Example: provider webhook intake
summary: A synthetic example of a proposed webhook flow that keeps an existing normalization contract. Replace every field with your own design.

flow_groups.title: Webhook arrival
flow_groups.entrypoint: A provider submits a notification to the intake route.

steps.title: Accept the notification
steps.explanation: The route verifies the signature, acknowledges delivery, and queues normalization. Duplicate notifications reuse the event identity.

steps.title: Deliver the normalized event
steps.explanation: The worker normalizes the payload and submits the reviewed shape to the pipeline. A retry never creates a second logical event.

setup.requirement: Store as a deployment secret, never in the repo

open_items: Prove duplicate handling and delivery retries against the pipeline runtime.
